name: Classification Rule
description: One rule. Rules evaluate in priority order and the first match wins; which rule matched is recorded.

fields.label: Condition
fields.description: A structured expression over question codes and answer codes, so it can be validated, diffed and rendered back to an administrator. Never free-form code.

fields.label: Outcome
fields.description: Free text, not a Select, so a new outcome needs no code change.
